summary: Helport AI Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Sales Agreement with Lake Street Capital Markets, LLC for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $9,550,000 in ordinary shares. The agent will use commercially reasonable efforts to sell shares at prices and times instructed by the company, with a 3% commission and customary indemnification. Shares are offered under an existing F-3 shelf registration. This is a routine equity distribution facility, not a special situation event. No activist involvement, strategic review, or corporate action is present.
